title: Shared definitions of the OpenBeach data formats
description: Not a file format: the other schemas reference these definitions (docs/architecture/data-formats/schemas.md).

version.description: Format version; the engine reads the versions it knows and refuses newer ones.

key.description: Content key: lowercase ASCII, compared exactly.

text_key.description: Key of an entry of the text table (text/<lang>.json).

path.description: File path relative to the pack root (or to the referencing file where a format says so), with '/' separators, lowercase, without '.' or '..' segments.

tier.description: Data tier: 0 own content, 1 simulation data, 2 media (principles.md, 'Data tiers').

range.description: A [low, high] pair of numbers; low may exceed high, and endpoints are not reordered.

by_gender.description: A value for men and one for women.

terrain.description: Ground a building or scenery object may stand on.
